moments.text: Grey-scale infrared view looking down on farmland through haze, crosshair at centre, grey borders on both sides.
Two tiny dark dots enter at the right side and drift down-left, leaving at the bottom edge.
As the sensor pans over fields, a tiny dark dash comes in at the lower left and moves up toward the centre.
After a white flash the view zooms in; three tiny dark dots in a short line slide from the centre toward the lower left.
The sensor brings the three dark dots, in a neat line, near the crosshair, then above and right of it.
One dot drifts away upward while the other two stay close together.
A dark pair comes in from the top and moves down to the crosshair; pairs of dots pass close to the crosshair until the end.
